event.title: Court to Rule on AFCON Title Dispute Between Senegal and Morocco
event.canonical_title: Court to Rule on AFCON Title Dispute Between Senegal and Morocco
event.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport is set to deliver a verdict within days regarding the appeal over the Africa Cup of Nations title, which Senegal was stripped of following a controversial final against Morocco in January. Both teams are contesting the outcome of that match.

timeline.title: Court to Rule on AFCON Title Dispute Between Senegal and Morocco
timeline.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport is set to deliver a verdict within days regarding the appeal over the Africa Cup of Nations title, which Senegal was stripped of following a controversial final against Morocco in January. Both teams are contesting the outcome of that match.
key_facts: Senegal and Morocco contested the AFCON title in January.
The Court of Arbitration for Sport is reviewing an appeal regarding the title.
A decision is expected within days.

timeline.title: CAS to Rule on Senegal's AFCON Title Appeal by End of November
timeline.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) has announced that it will deliver a verdict on Senegal's appeal regarding the Africa Cup of Nations title, which was awarded to Morocco, by the end of November.
key_facts: CAS will announce a verdict on Senegal's AFCON title appeal.
The title was awarded to Morocco by the Confederation of African Football (CAF).
The decision is expected by the end of November.
